summary: Verified iteration 13's fix for the broadcast Cloudflare 524 timeout bug. Backend: POST /api/admin/broadcast now returns in <1s with {queued:true, total:N} using FastAPI BackgroundTasks; confirmed via pytest with elapsed-time assertion. Waited 15s and confirmed GET /api/bot/status.last_broadcast is populated with {sent, failed, total, completed_at} matching the queued total. Auth/validation boundaries unchanged: 401 without auth, 400 for empty message+no file; code path for bot_module.is_ready() check confirmed to run synchronously before queuing (would still 503 immediately, not applicable in this env since bot is ready). Frontend: unlocked panel with PIN 246810, typed a message in broadcast-message-input, clicked broadcast-send, and broadcast-status appeared in 0.35s showing 'queued — sending to 29 users now' in emerald green (rgb(52,211,153)), textarea cleared immediately. Old 'sent to X/Y' text format no longer appears anywhere. Regression pass: /api/r bridge returns 302, GET /api/settings public 200, PUT /api/settings requires auth (401) -- all pass, no regression from iteration 12's webhook migration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/admin/broadcast: correctly moved the actual send loop into an inner run_broadcast() coroutine registered via background_tasks.add_task, while keeping is_ready() check and total count synchronous before responding -- this preserves fast-fail semantics (503) while fixing the 524 timeout for the success path. Good fix, matches the described architecture exactly.
last_broadcast write uses upsert=True on db.bot_meta._id='runtime', consistent with existing meta doc pattern used elsewhere (bot_username etc.) -- no schema conflict observed.

Minor observation (not a bug): if the server process restarts/crashes between queuing and background task completion, the broadcast total sent will be lost with no persisted 'in-progress' state -- acceptable given current low-stakes single-admin use case, not worth fixing now.

Exception in run_broadcast() is caught and logged (logger.exception) but last_broadcast is never updated in that failure case, so admin would see stale/no last_broadcast with no indication that the last attempt failed -- minor UX gap, not a functional bug.
seed_data_creation: Two test broadcasts sent to real test users during this iteration (one via pytest, one via UI/Playwright) per instructions limit of 1-2 broadcasts -- both used TEST_ prefixed / clearly test-labeled message text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 (broadcast async/BackgroundTasks fix for Cloudflare 524) fully verified end-to-end on backend (fast response + last_broadcast population) and frontend (queued status text, green color, immediate clear). No bugs found. Regression pass on bridge/settings from earlier iterations also passed. Webhook migration (iter 12) not re-verified in depth per instructions but no signs of regression observed (bot_username populated, bot is_ready true, unique_users count consistent at 29 across requests).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A for this iteration -- this was verification of a previously diagnosed and fixed bug (synchronous per-user Telegram send loop blocking the HTTP response past the platform gateway timeout). Fix (BackgroundTasks + immediate queued response) confirmed working correctly.
